errors.description: BLUEPRINT DEFECT, not merely a generation defect. The option is labelled 'Small Square 5.0 cm' and its own description states it is 'finished with squared rather than pointed tips' — but the tech-pack illustration at /images/ai/collar-small-sq-50.png itself shows a collar with sharp ACUTE POINTED tips. The candidate faithfully reproduced the illustration and is therefore also a pointed collar. Shipping it would put a point collar in front of a customer under a 'Small Square' label.
errors.expected: A compact 5.0 cm collar terminating in flat squared-off tips, per the option label and description.
errors.actual: Both the illustration AND the candidate show acute pointed collar tips. The candidate matches the drawing but contradicts the customer-facing label.
errors.correction: DO NOT regenerate against this illustration — a faithful render will reproduce the same wrong geometry and score highly while remaining wrong. The illustration is either mis-assigned or mislabelled and must be resolved upstream (tech-pack-interpreter / catalog owner) before any further credits are spent on this option.

errors.expected: No collar closure button — measured.flags for this option is empty; the button belongs to collar-small-sq-50-btn.
errors.actual: A four-hole throat button is rendered at the neckband in the candidate, mirroring the same button in the illustration.
errors.correction: Resolve alongside the shape defect: confirm whether the illustration for collar-small-sq-50 has been swapped with the -btn variant's drawing. If so, both options need their illustrations re-mapped before regeneration.
